semantic_insights: The latest-version DOI and release-specific DOI are explicitly distinguished, resolving an apparent identifier difference without treating it as a contradiction.
The record consistently separates the PhysioNet feature release from the controlled-access raw audio on Synapse.
SickKids REB approval is distinguished from the parent USF protocol; pediatric protections borrowed from the parent protocol are explicitly attributed.
Funding discrepancies across cited source descriptions are disclosed, while the recorded award remains tied to the pediatric release.
Processing software is linked to transformations of distributed data, with b2aiprep version and repository information strengthening reproducibility.
Several deductions concern unpopulated registered scoring representations despite useful narrative elsewhere; those narratives were considered and were not described as wholly absent.
